Overview.Name: Kalva Dileep kumar
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & boiled egg (1)
Option 3: Paneer bhurji (70 g) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & grilled chicken (moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since fried food is a craving, choose pan cooked chicken or eggs instead of deep fried items.
Keep lunch slightly stronger with protein to maintain steady energy during work hours.
Because sleep is less than 6 hours, keep dinner lighter to support recovery and reduce fatigue.
During social gatherings eat protein foods first to naturally control portion size.
Simple home style cooking will help you stay consistent long term.
